name: Staybell Bombardiers
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy strategy game animated sprite source. True transparent RGBA background. Exactly four full-body poses of ONE original upgraded Brasshollow creature in a perfectly regular 2x2 grid with equal square cells, wide clear transparent gutters. Painterly richly textured fantasy unit art, weathered brass and soot-black iron, warm directional light. Right-facing three-quarter camera; same identity, design, equipment, proportions and scale in all four cells. Full body and all weapons visible with generous 8% margin EACH cell. Same planted feet/paws positions in every cell. Four genuinely articulated idle keyframes reading row-major, visibly different joint and equipment angles; no static duplicate cutouts. No text, caption, watermark, gridlines, checkerboard, environment, scenery, floor or platform.  CRITICAL LAYOUT: make sheet square 1536x1536. Each of 4 cells is768x768. Draw characters substantially SMALLER within cells: subject occupies at most 70% of cell height and width, leave a full100px EMPTY margin on ALL sides of each subject. Nothing may touch outer image boundary or central seams.Creature Staybell Bombardiers. ONE complete weapon-team unit: compact bell-mouth mortar on short two-wheel brass carriage, large blue-black cooling cistern behind, broad iron braces, and ONE hooded bell-ringer attendant standing at rear left with a long crank lever. Original medieval industrial fantasy, mortar shaped like a broad upside-down brass bell, not modern artillery. Idle: 1 hooded attendant holds lever low with bent elbow mortar angle low; 2 attendant flexes elbow drawing lever up, mortar elevates slightly at trunnion; 3 lever high close to chest, mortar elevated further; 4 lever halfway down and mortar settles. Wheels/attendant boots fixed contact. Whole attendant, wheels, barrel and cistern within each cell.
reference_use: Original generation based on approved unit upgrade design brief.
